section.title: org.osgi.service.typedevent
section.para: Typed Event Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.

listitem.para: TopicPermission - A bundle's authority to publish or subscribe to typed events on a topic.
TypedEventConstants - Defines standard names for Typed Event properties.

section.title: public final class TopicPermission extends Permission
section.para: A bundle's authority to publish or subscribe to typed events on a topic.
A topic is a slash-separated string that defines a topic.
For example:
section.programlisting: org / osgi / service / foo / FooEvent / ACTION
section.para: Topics may also be given a default name based on the event type that is published to the topic. These use the fully qualified class name of the event object as the name of the topic.
For example:
TopicPermission has two actions: publish and subscribe.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

section.title: public static final String PUBLISH = "publish"
section.para: The action string publish.

section.title: public static final String SUBSCRIBE = "subscribe"
section.para: The action string subscribe.

section.title: public TopicPermission(String name, String actions)

formalpara.title: name
formalpara.para: Topic name.

formalpara.title: actions
formalpara.para: publish,subscribe (canonical order).

section.para: Defines the authority to publish and/or subscribe to a topic within the Typed Event service specification.
The name is specified as a slash-separated string. Wildcards may be used. For example:

A bundle that needs to publish events on a topic must have the appropriate TopicPermission for that topic; similarly, a bundle that needs to subscribe to events on a topic must have the appropriate TopicPermssion for that topic.

section.para:
Determines the equality of two TopicPermission objects.
This method checks that specified TopicPermission has the same topic name and actions as this TopicPermission object.

section.title: public String getActions()
section.para: Returns the canonical string representation of the TopicPermission actions.
Always returns present TopicPermission actions in the following order: publish,subscribe.

formalpara.title: Returns

section.title: public boolean implies(Permission p)

formalpara.title: p
formalpara.para: The target permission to interrogate.

section.para: Determines if the specified permission is implied by this object.

This method checks that the topic name of the target is implied by the topic name of this object. The list of TopicPermission actions must either match or allow for the list of the target object to imply the target TopicPermission action.
section.programlisting: x/y/*,"publish" -> x/y/z,"publish" is true *,"subscribe" -> x/y,"subscribe" is true *,"publish" -> x/y,"subscribe" is false x/y,"publish" -> x/y/z,"publish" is false

formalpara.title: Returns

section.title: public interface TypedEventBus
section.para: The Typed Event service. Bundles wishing to publish events must obtain this service and call one of the event delivery methods.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public void deliver(Object event)

formalpara.title: event
formalpara.para: The event to send to all listeners which subscribe to the topic of the event.

section.para: Initiate asynchronous, ordered delivery of an event. This method returns to the caller before delivery of the event is completed. Events are delivered in the order that they are received by this method.
The topic for this event will be automatically set to the fully qualified type name for the supplied event object.
Logically equivalent to calling deliver(event.getClass().getName().replace('.', '/'), event)

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: NullPointerException– if the event object is null

section.title: public void deliver(String topic, Object event)

formalpara.title: topic
formalpara.para: The topic to which this event should be sent.

formalpara.title: event
formalpara.para: The event to send to all listeners which subscribe to the topic.

section.para: Initiate asynchronous, ordered delivery of an event. This method returns to the caller before delivery of the event is completed. Events are delivered in the order that they are received by this method.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: NullPointerException– if the event object is null

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if the topic name is not valid

section.title: public void deliverUntyped(String topic, Map<String, ?> event)

formalpara.title: topic
formalpara.para: The topic to which this event should be sent.

formalpara.title: event
formalpara.para: A Map representation of the event data to send to all listeners which subscribe to the topic.

section.para: Initiate asynchronous, ordered delivery of event data. This method returns to the caller before delivery of the event is completed. Events are delivered in the order that they are received by this method.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: NullPointerException– if the event map is null

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if the topic name is not valid

section.title: public final class TypedEventConstants
section.para: Defines standard names for Typed Event properties.

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public static final String TYPED_EVENT_FILTER = "event.filter"
section.para: The name of the service property used to indicate a filter that should be applied to events from the TYPED_EVENT_TOPICS. Only events which match the filter will be delivered to the Event Handler service.
If this service property is not present then all events from the topic(s) will be delivered to the Event Handler service.

section.title: public static final String TYPED_EVENT_IMPLEMENTATION = "osgi.typedevent"
section.para: The name of the implementation capability for the Typed Event specification

section.title: public static final String TYPED_EVENT_SPECIFICATION_VERSION = "1.0"
section.para: The version of the implementation capability for the Typed Event specification

section.title: public static final String TYPED_EVENT_TOPICS = "event.topics"
section.para: The name of the service property used to indicate the topic(s) to which an a TypedEventHandler or UntypedEventHandler service is listening.
If this service property is not present then the reified type parameter from the TypedEventHandler implementation class will be used to determine the topic.

section.title: public static final String TYPED_EVENT_TYPE = "event.type"
section.para: The name of the service property used to indicate the type of the event objects received by a TypedEventHandler service.
If this service property is not present then the reified type parameter from the TypedEventHandler implementation class will be used.

section.title: public interface TypedEventHandler<T>

formalpara.title: <T>
formalpara.para: The type of the event to be received

section.para: Listener for Typed Events.
TypedEventHandler objects are registered with the Framework service registry and are notified with an event object when an event is sent.

TypedEventHandler objects are expected to reify the type parameter T with the type of object they wish to receive when implementing this interface. This type can be overridden using the TypedEventConstants.TYPED_EVENT_TOPICS service property.
TypedEventHandler objects may be registered with a service property TypedEventConstants.TYPED_EVENT_TOPICS whose value is the list of topics in which the event handler is interested.
For example:

formalpara.para: Thread-safe

formalpara.title: event
formalpara.para: The event that occurred.

section.para: Listener for Unhandled Events.
